description: She wears a dark green floor-length patterned gown with a low square neckline and elbow-length sleeves. Gold geometric borders decorate the neckline, center front, cuffs and hem. A broad decorated belt has round metal ornaments and a hanging tassel. An ivory wrap with gold cloud-patterned ornament hangs around her forearms, with a light underlayer visible through the low walking opening. Brown decorated closed boots are visible; her head is bare.
